content.value_statement: Creators need fast drafts that keep a clear angle and strong hooks. This skill turns source material into routed Chinese social posts with three styles.
actual_capabilities: Routes source material to T1, T2, T3, or T4 content templates.
Creates three draft styles: viral, deep insight, and hybrid fusion.
Generates four hook styles for each draft.
Scores drafts on curiosity, resonance, clarity, and shareability.
Suggests a posting time with a short reason.
Formats results as a Markdown content generation report.
limitations: Does not publish content directly to social platforms.
Does not fetch live trend data or verify facts.
May amplify sensitive angles if outputs are not reviewed.

use_cases.title: Plan campaign posts
use_cases.description: Turn product updates or events into several post angles with hooks and scoring.

use_cases.title: Draft faster daily posts
use_cases.description: Convert personal observations into structured short-form drafts for testing.

use_cases.title: Package business lessons
use_cases.description: Rewrite lessons, case studies, or offers into concise posts with a clear call to action.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Defou x Stanley workflow to create one social post from this topic: [topic]. Keep the tone sharp but factual.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Template Route
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this source material: [material]. Choose T1, T2, T3, or T4, then explain the routing choice.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Three Versions
prompt_templates.prompt: Create three versions from this material: [material]. Include hooks, scoring, and a recommended posting time.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Full Content Report
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with audience and goal
prompt_templates.prompt: For audience [audience] and goal [goal], transform [material] into a full report with angles, three drafts, hooks, scores, and publishing advice.

output_examples.input: A founder wants to explain what a failed product launch taught the team.
output: Routing selects the practical value template because the material is a business lesson.
The report proposes three angles, including cost of delay and unclear customer pain.
Three drafts are produced with different depth and viral strength.
Hooks and scores help the user choose the final version.

output_examples.input: A creator has notes about overspending on online courses.
output: Routing selects the counter-motivation template because the topic challenges a common belief.
The best angle frames the course purchase as anxiety spending.
Drafts include short hooks, a deeper explanation, and a balanced hybrid version.
The publishing advice suggests a reflective evening time.

output_examples.input: A marketer wants to turn a customer success story into a post.
output: Routing selects the monetization and practical value template.
The report identifies the strongest proof point and removes weak details.
The final drafts emphasize problem, method, outcome, and next step.

best_practices: Provide concrete source material with facts, numbers, or events.
State the target audience and publishing goal before requesting drafts.
Review facts, tone, and brand fit before publishing any output.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for viral content without source material or audience context.
Do not treat the scores as a guarantee of platform performance.
Do not use generated claims without checking accuracy and fairness.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates routed Chinese social content drafts with hooks, scores, and publishing advice.

faq.question: Does it post to social media?
faq.answer: No. It only generates drafts and recommendations for manual review.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What are T1, T2, T3, and T4?
faq.answer: They are templates for hot topics, counter-motivation, humorous observation, and practical value sharing.

faq.question: Can it verify facts or trends?
faq.answer: No. Users must verify facts, current events, and performance claims separately.

faq.question: Is it only for Chinese content?
faq.answer: The instructions are designed for Chinese content. Other languages may need prompt adaptation.
